Anyone with skill and interest is welcome to learn and yearn. The scope is to make a user-friendly application with detailed include of cosmic architecture and stellar physics learning.
summary: Astra Forge is a game-based platform that helps students to learn and build the engineering bay behind various space launches and their trajectories under 3D scale stimulator to enhance practical visualisation. The application includes map categories from LEO to Deep Space Orbit with Stellar Atlas and Future Trend Space Technologies to examine game-based learning and engage curiosity among future Astronauts.
details:
Astra Forge is a free browser game that teaches space mission design. Players choose one of five levels, from Earth orbit to the Moon, Mars, the inner Solar System and deep space, set an objective and a real launch date, and pick real rockets and spacecraft from ten nations. In the engineering bay they tune 40 to 65 parameters while physics models check mass, power, fuel, data and budget. A Space Atlas and a Future Tech Lab extend the learning.

It turns abstract formulas into hands-on practice, shows trade-offs instantly, rewards learning through iteration, and runs free on any phone or laptop with nothing to install.

JavaScript, HTML and CSS; three.js r186 with Web GPU (WebGL 2 fallback) and custom TSL shaders; astronomy-engine for planetary positions; glTF-Transform for 3D models; Python and Playwright for data preparation and testing; GitHub Pages for hosting. Data comes from NASA 3D Resources, NASA Blue Marble, Natural Earth and the Hipparcos star catalogue. No special hardware is needed.

Astra Forge combines a game, an engineering tool and a live planetarium. Real launch sites, real sky and real spacecraft make every mission feel authentic, while the Future Tech Lab lets players test tomorrow’s propulsion today.
